items.headline: Z.ai releases GLM-4.5V vision-language model
items.summary: GLM-4.5V is an MIT-licensed vision-language model built on GLM-4.5-Air (106B total, 12B active parameters) covering image and video understanding, GUI tasks, document parsing and grounding. Z.ai claims state-of-the-art results among models of its scale on 42 public vision-language benchmarks.
